def min_elevator_time(n, employees):

    current_floor = 1
    time = 0
    
    # List to keep track of passengers in the elevator

            current_floor = start

            in_elevator = new_in_elevator
            
            # If the elevator is full, move to the next floor

            # Let passengers get in if there is space

                next_floor = in_elevator[0][1]

                    time += next_floor - current_floor
                    current_floor = next_floor
                elif next_floor < current_floor:
                    time += current_floor - next_floor
                    current_floor = next_floor
    
    return time
